description:
Query Crm

Read your authorized CRM records with bounded, read-only PostgreSQL SQL.

Omit query to discover crm_v1 accounts, people, relationships, activities,
deals and objectives and their exact columns. Join and aggregate these
views using normal SELECT, nonrecursive CTEs and subqueries. Every relation
enforces your current workspace and principal scope in the database, even
when SQL contains no workspace filter. Select id and record_path when you
need to cite a record. Results include the query, freshness, truncation and
an audit ID. Paginated reads are fresh snapshots with live authorization.
Private messages, secrets, raw financial data and unexposed columns are
unavailable. Mutations and sends use the existing Vruum tools.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "schema_version": "Schema Version",
  "mode": "Mode",
  "examples": [
    {}
  ],
  "coverage": [
    "string"
  ],
  "columns": [
    "string"
  ],
  "rows": [
    {}
  ],
  "row_count": 1,
  "truncated": true,
  "freshness": {},
  "limits": {}
}
```

for_company.description: Optional company ID or name (UUID, or case-insensitive EXACT name match — partial / substring matches are NOT supported; ambiguous names raise 400) to execute this tool as. Use get_operator_companies, or get_operator_overview with view='companies', to list available companies. Only needed if you manage multiple companies. Access is enforced server-side: the tool resolves the value to a user_company_id and verifies the caller's membership in `company_users` — a 403 'Company not found or access denied' means EITHER the value did not match a known company OR the caller is not a member of it. The MCP operator role itself is NOT auto-granted — operators get this access by being members of each client company via `company_users` (the same row that grants any normal user access).
for_company.title: for_company

offset.description: Each page reauthorizes and reads fresh data. Use an explicit deterministic ORDER BY for subsequent pages.
offset.title: offset

query.description: One PostgreSQL SELECT over crm_v1. Omit to discover its exact versioned schema. No writes or external calls.
query.title: query
